sample_data.method: The app ships with a bundled household dataset and a built static page in index.html. The tariff logic is implemented in engine.py and the public-case validation is managed by solve.py and tests.py.
sample_data.reset_instructions: Reload the page to restore the built-in data. The front-end and generated dataset are in-memory only and not persisted.

problem_solving_method: This project uses a single deterministic tariff engine in engine.py to compute slab pricing, daily ledger balances, run-out dates, and recharge recommendations. The browser version in index.html reads the embedded data produced by build_data.py and renders the results visually without any backend or build pipeline. solve.py validates the public cases and tests.py contains 252 self-checks to confirm correctness against the tariff rules.

R1.evidence: Deterministic tariff calculations and validation logic are implemented in engine.py, solve.py, and tests.py. The README states that there are 252 self-checks covering public cases and invariants.

R2.evidence: The interactive calculator and results view are in index.html, with the UI generation and embedded data prepared via build_data.py and template.html. The app presents household summaries, daily balance details, and tariff breakdowns in-browser.

R3.evidence: The application computes daily ledger runs, run-out dates, recharge-to-target amounts, and monthly habit comparisons, matching the rules described in README.md. This is the core functionality of the prepaid meter advisor.

R4.evidence: The project is a static HTML app with no runtime dependency or build step required. README.md explicitly states it can be opened directly in a browser and is suitable for static deployment such as Netlify.

team_members.registered_name: Meheer Ali Khan | Abu Ruhan Mahamud
team_members.major_contribution: Designed and implemented the tariff engine, validation tooling, generated dataset pipeline, browser UI, documentation, and verification logic.

major_design_decisions: Single source of truth: all tariff arithmetic is computed in engine.py and shared across the CLI and browser versions.
Static deployment model: the app is delivered as plain HTML/CSS/JS and runs without a framework or build pipeline.
Deterministic validation: solve.py and tests.py verify all public cases and invariants before trusting the result.
No external runtime dependency: the only network fetch is the optional IBM Plex font, and the app falls back to system fonts.
known_limitations: Data is bundled and in-memory; reloading the page restores the default fixture.
The project is designed for browser-based static use, not as a multi-user backend service.
The front-end is static and does not persist imported or edited data beyond the current session.

ai_tools_used.used_for: Implementing the tariff engine, generated data pipeline, browser UI, and verification checks.
ai_tools_used.how_output_was_verified: Verified against the documented rule set and the 252 self-checks in tests.py, as described in README.md.
